list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide in order: story first, then side strands and activities, then collectibles, then the long counters. Check the progress ring in the sidebar; when it reads 54 of 55, the last trophy you earn triggers this one.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1).
Clear side strands, activities and collectibles (Stages 2–3).
Grind the final counters to 100% completion (Stage 4).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks through normal story play at the start of the game. Follow the on-screen objectives — the mission teaches fishing and introduces Lucia and Jason — and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed; if you somehow leave the mission, replay it from the pause menu.
steps: Start the story and follow the Gone Fishing objectives.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends and the next chapter begins. Story chapters cannot be skipped or locked out, so just keep following the main mission markers. If you get stuck on a mission, retry it from the pause menu — progress within the chapter is kept.
steps: Play each Chapter 1 mission in order.
Finish the chapter's last mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions to earn this one. The chapter builds on the drug-trade storyline, so expect more driving, deals and shootouts than Chapter 1; stock up on armour and ammo between missions. Like every chapter trophy, it is unmissable — it pops the moment the chapter closes.
steps: Play each Chapter 2 mission in order.
Finish the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3, which takes the story deep into Vice City itself. Keep pushing the main mission markers; side activities can wait until after the story if you want a clean run. The trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission ends.
steps: Play each Chapter 3 mission in order.
Finish the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. By now the missions are at their hardest, so use cover, keep a stocked weapon wheel and save between missions. The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes and the final mission unlocks.
steps: Play each Chapter 4 mission in order.
Finish the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission to take this gold trophy. It unlocks after Chapter 4, so finish the chapters first. Go in prepared — full armour, your best weapons and a fast getaway vehicle — and follow the mission's objectives step by step; the trophy pops at the end credits sequence.
steps: Complete Chapters 1–4.
Start and finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission; play it when its marker appears and finish it to earn the trophy. It is a trust-building job early in the story, so expect a mix of driving and a light shootout. Unmissable — it pops at mission completion and can be replayed from the pause menu if you fail.
steps: Follow the Breakfast Run mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the big story set-pieces: a planned robbery against the cartel. Prepare before you start — armour, ammo and a getaway car — then follow the heist's phases in order. The trophy unlocks when the heist mission completes; failing a phase just restarts that checkpoint.
steps: Stock armour and ammo before starting.
Complete The Cartel Heist mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission centred on family business; play it when its marker appears and see it through to the end. It mixes conversation and action, so pay attention to the objectives as they change mid-mission. The trophy pops at the mission's end screen.
steps: Follow the Child's Play mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission that puts Lucia and Jason in the spotlight — literally, with a show-business angle. Follow the mission markers, complete each objective, and the trophy unlocks when the mission wraps. Like all story missions it is unmissable and replayable.
steps: Follow the Headliners mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission at Vice City International Airport — expect tight corridors, armed security and a vehicle escape. Bring a rifle and armour, move cover to cover, and follow the takedown objectives. The trophy pops when the mission completes; see also Catch Me If You Can, which is about leaving the same airport in an unscheduled way.
steps: Stock a rifle and armour.
Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a large-scale story operation — the name promises a storm of a mission. Go in with full armour and your best automatic weapon, use the mission's checkpoints, and push through each phase. The trophy unlocks at the mission's end.
steps: Stock full armour and a strong automatic weapon.
Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats — the gold trophy for doing everything. That means all story missions, all stranger strands, all activities, collectibles, stunts, races and the counters this guide tracks. Do it last: the roadmap's Stages 1–3 feed directly into it, and the stats screen shows your percentage so you can see what is left. Use the checklist filters to sweep up the remaining categories.
steps: Finish the story and all side strands.
Clear every collectible and activity category.
Check the stats screen until it reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime, drifts and other driving feats the game counts as stunts. The fastest farm is a fast bike or sports car on the long highway jumps and ramps around Vice City: hit a ramp, land cleanly on all wheels and keep going. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stunt from your story run already counts; the stats screen shows your total.
steps: Use a fast bike or sports car.
Hit ramps and jumps, landing cleanly.
Repeat until the counter reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — fishing, the Shooting Range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, racing, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities the game lists. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so dip into each and move on. The activity list in the pause menu shows which types you have tried; work through it in Stage 2.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu.
Try each of the 9 activity types once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a range, pick a challenge and beat its gold score or time — use the weapon the challenge gives you, aim for headshots where they pay, and replay any challenge you miss gold on; every challenge can be retried as often as you like. Work through the list one weapon class at a time and tick them off in the checklist as you go.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range.
Gold each of the 42 challenges, replaying any you miss.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course: learn the gates, cut corners where the course allows, and use boost on the straights. Losing a race costs nothing — just retry it. The map marks race locations once you have found them, so sweep them county by county in Stage 3.
steps: Find each Top Fun race location.
Win the drone race at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins of the same race. Mix street races, off-road and circuit events, and pick a car suited to each surface. Winning the same race again does not add to the count, so keep moving to new events and tick them off here as you win them.
steps: Enter a race you have not won before.
Win 20 different races in total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missable_note: You can lose the challenge against Cal — losing does not lock the trophy, but you must beat him in a fresh attempt, so challenge him when you are confident with the fishing mechanics.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge, then out-fish him: cast where the water ripples, keep tension in the green zone while reeling, and do not let the line snap. Practice the fishing minigame first on your own so the timing is familiar, then take Cal on and land the bigger catch.
steps: Learn the fishing minigame at any fishing spot.
Challenge Cal and land the bigger catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Head to an arcade, pick the shortest game on the cabinet — a simple high-score or level-based game — and play it to its end screen. You do not need a high score, just a completion, so choose the easiest cabinet and take your time.
steps: Find an arcade and pick a cabinet.
Play the game through to its end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — play every mission he gives you, in order, until his final one. Stranger missions appear as question-mark markers on the map; follow them as they come and do not leave the last one hanging. The trophy pops when Andy's final mission completes.
steps: Follow Andy's stranger markers.
Complete his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, which — true to the name — involves boats and the water around Leonida. Play his missions in order until the last one; the boat handling matters, so take the approach slowly and use the throttle gently in tight spots. The trophy unlocks at the end of his final mission.
steps: Follow Kenton's stranger markers.
Complete his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, a lone-rider storyline best played on a bike. Follow his markers, complete each of his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his final mission ends. Keep a fast motorcycle handy for his jobs — several are built around riding.
steps: Follow Billy's stranger markers on a bike.
Complete his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the individual strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone count toward this, plus the other stranger characters you meet on the map. Question-mark markers are the key: visit every one, take the mission, and finish each strand to its end. The trophy pops when the eighth strand is done; it is a silver, so expect a decent chunk of Stage 2 to go here.
steps: Visit every stranger (?) marker on the map.
Finish 8 full stranger strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, which revolves around supply runs and demand — deliveries, pickups and the occasional shootout when a deal goes wrong. Play his missions in order until the final one; bring a sturdy vehicle with room for cargo. The trophy pops at the end of his last mission.
steps: Follow Randy's stranger markers.
Complete his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand — the title hints at spinning, so expect vehicle work, likely drifting or stunt driving. Play his missions in order, and for any driving test, use a car with good handling rather than top speed. The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
steps: Follow Tyrone's stranger markers.
Complete his missions through to the final one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic overlooks and quiet places — beaches, hilltops, parks — marked once you get close or find them. Visit each one, start the meditation prompt and let the short scene play out. Sweep them county by county in Stage 3 and tick them off; the game tracks how many you have done.
steps: Find a meditation spot and use the prompt.
Meditate at all 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Meet Bret, take his hunting job, then track the marked animal — follow the trail, move quietly, and take a clean shot with a scoped rifle rather than spraying. The animal is unique, so there is only one of its kind; once you bring it down and return to Bret, the trophy pops.
steps: Meet Bret and take the hunt.
Track and down the unique animal, then return to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, on shelves, in drawers and out in the world — and each set needs every card in it. Pick up every card you see, check the collection menu to see which sets are nearly done, and trade or hunt down the last cards for three sets. The trophy pops when the third set completes.
steps: Collect cards wherever you find them.
Check the collection menu and finish 3 complete sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo/sharing action at landmarks and viewpoints — when the prompt appears at a spot, use it to log that location. The counter needs 100 distinct spots, so keep moving: city landmarks, beaches, swamps and roadside attractions all count. The stats screen tracks your total.
steps: Use WAiNK It at a landmark when prompted.
Log 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's checklist of feats, from driving and shooting to exploration and activities. The challenges menu lists them all with progress bars; knock out the easy ones first (short drives, simple stunts, first-time activities), then work through the longer ones. This is a Stage 4 cleanup trophy: by then, half the list is usually done already.
steps: Open the challenges menu.
Complete 50 challenges, easiest first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: The escape must happen with your partner beside you and the wanted level must actually reach 4 stars, then drop to zero — if your partner is left behind or you get busted, the attempt fails and you start over.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Lucia or Jason) in the car, raise your wanted level to 4 stars, then lose the cops and escape. Cause chaos in a quiet area first — shootouts and car chases build stars fast — then, once you hit 4 stars, break line of sight, take tunnels and back streets, and hide until the stars clear. Keep your partner with you the whole time; if they get separated, the attempt does not count.
steps: Bring your partner along.
Reach a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until the heat is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: All three robberies must happen in one chain with your partner and your wanted level intact — if the cops catch up or the level drops, the chain breaks and you start again from the first shop.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together on the map, hit them one after another, and keep moving — do not stop to fight the police. A fast car parked outside each shop makes the chain easy; if your wanted level clears between robberies, the chain breaks and you must start again.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 nearby shops.
Rob all three in a row, keeping your wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride in a vehicle type for the first time and it counts as discovered. Leonida is full of variety: cars, bikes, boats, trucks, buses and more, so hop into anything new you see rather than sticking to one favourite car. The vehicle list in the menu shows what you have found; rare spawns are worth chasing in Stage 3.
steps: Get into any vehicle you have not used before.
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missable_note: All five takedowns must happen inside one single Combat Focus activation — if the focus ends at four, the attempt fails and you try again.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming mode — and take down 5 enemies before it ends. The best spot is a busy shootout with enemies grouped together: trigger the focus, line up headshots quickly, and keep firing while it lasts. A weapon with a large magazine helps; if you only get four, reload the checkpoint and try again.
steps: Find a shootout with 5+ grouped enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and down 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: This is a specific stunt at the airport — a normal, scheduled-style exit does not count, so set it up deliberately with a fast vehicle and a clear runway.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane or drive a vehicle off the airport in a way no timetable allows. The classic route: get airside, grab a small plane, and take off without clearance, or smash through a gate in a fast car. Expect a wanted level; the trophy pops once you are away from the airport.
steps: Get airside at VCIA with a fast vehicle or plane.
Leave the airport by an unscheduled route.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_note: The Rhino tank moment is situational — you need a tank encounter and to survive it, so attempt it deliberately rather than hoping it happens by accident.
trophies.guide: Survive a run-in with a Rhino tank — the military tank that shows up at high wanted levels and in certain missions. When a Rhino appears, keep moving, use cover and explosives, and stay alive through the encounter; the trophy is about the heat of the moment, not destroying the tank. A high wanted level in an open area is the surest way to draw one out.
steps: Raise a high wanted level in an open area.
Survive the Rhino tank encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_note: Being spotted at any point ruins the attempt — plan the route, go at a quiet hour and retry if a guard or camera catches you.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first: watch the guards and cameras, enter quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Move slowly, avoid the line of sight of staff, and do not draw a weapon unless the run is already blown. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection only fails that attempt.
steps: Case the jewelry store's guards and cameras.
Rob it and leave without being seen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missable_note: Each vault robbery ends with an escape — getting caught or busted after cracking a vault means that vault does not count, so plan the getaway before you go in.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big heist-style robberies: crack the vault, grab the cash and get out before the police lock the area down. Scout the bank first, park a fast getaway car nearby, and use the same escape route each time. The counter tracks completed vault escapes, so failed attempts simply do not count.
steps: Scout a bank and park a getaway car.
Rob the vault and escape — repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missable_note: The escape is part of the trophy — cracking the truck but getting busted right after does not count, so have the getaway ready first.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — a classic GTA move. Find a truck on its route, stop it (block it with a vehicle or shoot out its tyres), crack the rear doors, grab the cash and drive away before the police arrive. A fast car and a quiet stretch of road make it far easier than trying it in downtown traffic.
steps: Find an armored truck on a quiet road.
Stop it, take the cash and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district, town, beach, swamp and stretch of countryside. The map fills in as you travel, so the simplest method is a long drive: take a fast car and sweep the highways and back roads county by county, dipping into each named area until it registers. Check the map for grey, unvisited patches and finish those last.
steps: Drive through every named area of Leonida.
Check the map for unvisited patches and clear them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run spots on the map — stash houses, chop shops and fronts — and each gang controls its own. Hit one per gang, take the goods and leave; the operations menu or map markers show which gangs you have hit. Work through the list gang by gang in Stage 4.
steps: Find an illegal operation on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet, scenic moment rather than a challenge. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Drive with an ocean view, order a cocktail and let the scene play. It is best done at sunset, when the view is at its best, and it pops once the drink scene completes.
steps: Go to a beach bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_note: This needs a proper showroom smash — driving out through the glass in style. A half-hearted exit through the front door does not count.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out onto the street, GTA-style. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a fast car inside or lined up outside, and floor it through the window. The trophy pops when you burst out — expect a wanted level, so have an escape route ready.
steps: Line a fast car up at a showroom's glass front.
Smash through and out onto the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Walk in, rent a lane and bowl a full game — follow through on your throws, aim for the pocket, and finish all the frames. You do not need a perfect game, just a completed one; the trophy pops at the end of the game.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: This is tied to a partnership moment with your in-game partner — it happens at a specific point in the story, so do it when the moment comes rather than assuming it can be done later.
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — a scene where Lucia and Jason's partnership lands with the public. This is a story-adjacent moment: play the story, and when the partnership beat arrives, see it through. Because it is tied to that moment, do not skip the cutscene or the objective when it appears.
steps: Play the story until the partnership moment.
See the moment through to its end.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Choices are the point of this one — the game tracks decisions up to a count of 500, so keep making choices in missions and side content rather than rushing past them.
trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks the decisions you take across missions and side content, up to a count of 500. Every time a mission offers you a choice (spare or not, which approach, which target), pick one and keep playing; the count builds across the whole playthrough. There is no single right answer, so choose freely and let the tally grow toward the target.
steps: Take the choice options missions offer you.
Keep choosing until the tracked count is reached.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: The trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt — if you nail something first try, this particular trophy waits for a moment where the second try is the one that lands.
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt — the trophy's own description says second time's the charm. In practice, this pops when you fail an activity or challenge once and then clear it on the immediate retry. If you fail a race, a challenge or a minigame, do not walk away: retry it right away and finish it, and the trophy should pop on that second success.
steps: Attempt an activity or challenge and fail once.
Retry it immediately and succeed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: This is a rare, strange random event — it cannot be forced on demand, so keep an eye out while roaming Leonida at night and in remote spots.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a rare, unexplained event out in Leonida. These moments are random encounters: odd lights, strange figures, things that do not quite make sense, usually at night or in remote places like the swamps and the Keys. Roam off the beaten path, especially after dark, and when something odd happens, stay and watch it through; the trophy pops when the event completes.
steps: Roam remote Leonida, especially at night.
Watch a strange random event through to the end.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable_note: The target must go down from the melee strike while you drive by — a normal drive-by shooting does not count, so set the attempt up with a slow vehicle and a clear target.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and connect. A slow car on a quiet street gives you the best aim; the trophy pops when the target goes down from the melee hit.
steps: Equip a melee weapon in a slow-moving car.
Strike a pedestrian with it as you drive by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who cleans money and exchange them in batches. Keep robbing vaults, trucks and shops to build up bills, and launder them regularly rather than letting them pile up. The counter tracks the total laundered, so it grows steadily through Stage 4.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through a contact until $250,000 is cleaned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything with a price tag. The total is cumulative across every shop, so normal play already covers much of it: buy ammo and armour regularly, customise a car, refresh your wardrobe. If you are short at the end, car modifications are the fastest way to burn through the remaining dollars.
steps: Shop normally — ammo, armour, clothes, car mods.
Top up with car modifications until $100,000 is spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are listed on the in-game property site and marked on the map; each one costs money, so save up and buy them one by one. They also give you somewhere to store the cars you collect for Whip It Good, so buy them as you go in Stage 4 and tick each one off here.
steps: Open the property listings and find the garages.
Purchase all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, add a vehicle you own or have just acquired, and repeat until ten are registered. Any ten vehicles count, so use the cars already sitting in your garages — buy the Little Boxes garages first and the vehicles you store there are ready to register.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register 10 vehicles.
